newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's Amen-Lease in notes issue.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's Amen-Lease in notes issue.

text.p: Tunisia's leasing company Amen Lease has launched a six million dinar ($6 million) five-year note issue, bourse sources said on Friday.
The issue of 60,000 notes, priced at 60 dinars each, carries a coupon of 9.5 percent.
Amen Lease, a subsidiary of privately-owned Amen Bank, last January issued nine million dinars of five-year notes at a 10.5 percent coupon.
The fall in the interest rate reflects the one point cut in money market rates last November.
The issue is garanteed by Amen Bank, BIAT bank, and BTEI bank. ($=one dinar)
